about: Register a company or a business-owning individual for UAE corporate tax.
note: Requirements read from the official FTA service page on the checked date. FTA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Corporate tax registration. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Companies and other legal persons that must or may register under FTA Decision No. 3 of 2024
Individuals must register if business revenue exceeds AED 1 million in a calendar year
Salary, private investment income and real estate investment income do not count towards that revenue
documents: Certificate of incorporation, memorandum or partnership agreement, if available
Commercial registration or other licensing document
Valid trade licence and branch licences
Emirates ID and passport of owners above 25% and of authorised signatories
PDF only, up to 15 MB per file
timing: FTA processes a complete application in 20 business days
channels: EmaraTax platform, sign in with UAE PASS
